profile.headline: Dynamics 365 CE / Power Platform / Solutions Architect
profile.summary:
I help organizations modernize and integrate legacy Microsoft systems into powerful, cloud-first solutions using Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and SharePoint.

With over a decade of experience solving complex technical challenges across multiple industries, I’ve become the go-to expert for:

- Migrating Dynamics 365 on-prem to cloud and integrating with Dataverse
- Designing Power Apps, Power Automate flows, Power Pages,  and custom connectors to streamline operations
- Re-architecting outdated SharePoint 2013/2016 environments into modern, scalable Microsoft 365 solutions
- Implementing CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform using DevOps best practices

Whether it's building secure, low-code apps, optimizing business processes, or leading large-scale transitions from legacy to modern platforms, I bring both the technical depth and strategic vision to drive impact.

Let’s connect if you're looking for someone who knows where the Microsoft stack has been, and where it's going.

positions.title: Tech Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Dynamics 365 Modernization & Migration – Led the enterprise-wide migration from Dynamics 365 on-premises to Dynamics 365 Cloud, including redesign and refactoring of legacy customizations. Replaced fully trusted plugins with scalable Power Apps and Power Automate solutions, ensuring long-term cloud compatibility. 

Enterprise System Integrations – Designed and implemented integrations between Dynamics 365 and third-party vendors including NPDB (National Practitioner Data Bank), HireRight, Origami Risk, Service Now and Echo for credentialing, background checks, and provider management. Developed secure plugins, APIs, and workflows to automate cross-platform data exchange. 

CI/CD & DevOps Pipelines – Established and maintained Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions across Dev, QA, UAT, and Prod environments. Automated solution packaging, deployment approvals, and release management to reduce errors and accelerate delivery. 

Legacy Application Ownership (Emcomp & Emtrac) – Maintained and modernized critical legacy systems: Emcomp – Payroll engine built in PowerBuilder with a .NET service layer and SQL backend. Led major upgrades including PowerBuilder version updates, SQL modernization, and integration from Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) to Oracle Cloud. Emtrac – Access 2000 application with SQL backend. Supported and stabilized the application, ensuring business continuity for operational teams. 

SharePoint/Dynamics 365 Integration – Managed and optimized a large SharePoint farm integrated with Dynamics 365. Built custom solutions to improve compliance, document management, and enterprise collaboration. 

Cloud Application Development – Built a SharePoint provider-hosted app in Office 365 integrating clinician data from systems including Emtime Scheduling, SuccessFactors, Oracle, and Dynamics 365. Enabled clinicians to securely access pay, schedules, training, credentials, and resources from a single portal.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Dynamics 365 · SharePoint · Microsoft Power Platform · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · DevOps
